frontmatter.name: title
frontmatter.description: Title of the page. Drives the visible heading, <title>, og:title, RSS, nav, breadcrumb, and link cards. Filename is used when this field is missing. Set to an empty string to suppress the auto-injected page heading.

frontmatter.name: description
frontmatter.description: Page excerpt for SEO meta, og:description, and list previews

frontmatter.name: date
frontmatter.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD)

frontmatter.name: tags
frontmatter.description: Content tags for organization

frontmatter.name: draft
frontmatter.description: Hidden from all listings, feeds, and navigation — still published at its direct URL

frontmatter.name: listed
frontmatter.description: When off, hidden from listings, feeds, and sitemap — but still indexed and reachable at its URL

frontmatter.name: logo
frontmatter.description: Site logo image path (rendered before site name in nav)

frontmatter.name: url
frontmatter.description: Custom URL path override

frontmatter.name: author
frontmatter.description: Author name (or 'A and B' / 'A, B, and C' for co-authors). Captured by moss import from JSON-LD / OpenGraph.

frontmatter.name: publisher
frontmatter.description: Publishing outlet name. Captured by moss import from schema.org publisher (resolved via @id) or OpenGraph site_name.

frontmatter.name: external_url
frontmatter.description: Linkblog target: when set, internal references to this page (cards, link rewrites, canonical, sitemap) point here instead of the local URL. The page is still built locally — direct visits to its slug still work — but the canonical home is elsewhere on the web. Pattern from JSON Feed 1.1.

frontmatter.name: cover
frontmatter.description: Cover image path

frontmatter.name: cover_type
frontmatter.description: Cover type override: image, video, or iframe (auto-detected if omitted)

frontmatter.name: lang
frontmatter.description: Language code (e.g. en, zh)

frontmatter.name: weight
frontmatter.description: Sort weight for ordering

frontmatter.name: nav
frontmatter.description: Whether to show in site navigation

frontmatter.name: home
frontmatter.description: Mark this file as its folder's home page (survives folder rename)

frontmatter.name: sort
frontmatter.description: How to sort children in this folder's listing. Use date for chronological streams, weight for authored order, title for alphabetical. A list of child stems (e.g. [intro, setup]) declares explicit order.

frontmatter.name: series
frontmatter.description: Declares children as sequential series. Use true for weight-based ordering, or a list of wikilinks for explicit order.

frontmatter.name: children
frontmatter.description: Whether to render child pages below content. Accepts true/false or a wikilink like [[News]] to render a specific folder's articles.

frontmatter.name: children_source
frontmatter.description: Internal: wikilink reference parsed from children field (e.g. [[News]])

frontmatter.name: children_style
frontmatter.description: How child pages are rendered

frontmatter.name: children_group
frontmatter.description: How children are grouped: year (default for list) or none (default for card)

frontmatter.name: children_depth
frontmatter.description: Whether to include only immediate children or all descendants

frontmatter.name: children_in
frontmatter.description: Where to render the children feed: body (after page content, default) or sidebar (right rail).

frontmatter.name: children_limit
frontmatter.description: Cap the feed at N items. If truncated, a 'More →' link is added. Absent = no cap.

frontmatter.name: _from_sidebar_alias
frontmatter.description: Internal: marks frontmatter that came from the deprecated sidebar: alias

frontmatter.name: breadcrumb
frontmatter.description: Override site-wide breadcrumb setting for this page

frontmatter.name: footer
frontmatter.description: Show as a link in the site footer

frontmatter.name: slot
frontmatter.description: Named slot to inject this page into (e.g. footer-left). Recognized values are validated at build time.

frontmatter.name: comments
frontmatter.description: Per-page comment opt-in/out

frontmatter.name: typesetting
frontmatter.description: Typesetting direction: horizontal (default) or vertical (right-to-left columns for CJK content)

frontmatter.name: content_width
frontmatter.description: Page width: default (67ch) for prose, wide (80ch) for grids/tables, full (site max) for dashboards

frontmatter.name: sidebar
frontmatter.description: Deprecated. Use children + children_in: sidebar. Wikilink to folder whose children appear in sidebar (e.g. [[News]]).

frontmatter.name: cascade
frontmatter.description: Frontmatter values to push to all descendant pages

frontmatter.name: also_in
frontmatter.description: Cross-list this page in other sections

frontmatter.name: translationKey
frontmatter.description: Key to link translations of the same content

frontmatter.name: review_of
frontmatter.description: URL of item being reviewed (activates review feature)

frontmatter.name: rating
frontmatter.description: Author's rating of the reviewed item (1-5)

frontmatter.name: analytics
frontmatter.description: Analytics configuration (site-level, read from homepage only)

frontmatter.name: uid
frontmatter.description: Stable note identity: 8 random hex chars minted at first build. NOT derived from the path or the content, and unrecoverable once lost (auto-generated)

frontmatter.name: layout
frontmatter.description: Template layout override (page or article)
